author: bardic-inspiration
name: Blazing Sling
summary: Hurls a ball of fire that splits into smaller flames on impact.

stats.effect: Make a ranged spell attack against a creature within range. On a hit, the target takes 6d6 Fire damage, and each creature within 10 feet of it makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d6 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much on a success.
